issue_context.title: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException while postprocessing download of 1080p60fps video
issue_context.body:
### Version - 0.19.0 RC5 ### Steps to reproduce the bug Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Open https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I5Zb4w03atU in NewPipe 2. Start a download with 1080p 60fps 3. Wait until download finished 4. Postprocessing fails at ~18% For more info, see https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/issues/3266#issuecomment-605659721 ### Logs ## Exception * __User Action:__ download post-processing * __Request:__ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I5Zb4w03atU [ {type=video format=MPEG-4 quality=1080p60 videoOnly=true} {type=audio format=m4a bitrate=128} ] * __Content Language:__ en_US * __Service:__ YouTube * __Version:__ 0.19.0 * __OS:__ Linux Android 10 - 29
Crash log

``` java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: src.length=7730 srcPos=-15217326 dst.length=8192 dstPos=0 length=8192 at java.lang.System.arraycopy(System.java:527) at us.shandian.giga.io.CircularFileWriter$BufferedFile.write(CircularFileWriter.java:405) at us.shandian.giga.io.CircularFileWriter.write(CircularFileWriter.java:231) at org.schabi.newpipe.streams.Mp4FromDashWriter.outWrite(Mp4FromDashWriter.java:502) at org.schabi.newpipe.streams.Mp4FromDashWriter.build(Mp4FromDashWriter.java:363) at us.shandian.giga.postprocessing.Mp4FromDashMuxer.process(Mp4FromDashMuxer.java:22) at us.shandian.giga.postprocessing.Postprocessing.run(Postprocessing.java:174) at us.shandian.giga.get.DownloadMission.doPostprocessing(DownloadMission.java:702) at us.shandian.giga.get.DownloadMission.lambda$1gGnKY4qsIM8af3LqOOlrMGS3J4(Unknown Source:0) at us.shandian.giga.get.-$$Lambda$DownloadMission$1gGnKY4qsIM8af3LqOOlrMGS3J4.run(Unknown Source:2) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:919) ```

@givemestella youtube-dl does the same thing first shows ~3GB and later 5GB

Ok interesting... So using youtube-dl it completes the DL with a warning in its logs.  "Requested formats are incompatible for merge and will be merged into mkv." The resultant 60fps .mkv is playable. Maybe this is why this fails in newpipe?
Also happens with 0.19.0 release not just rc5.
@givemestella i known, the file is to big. i still searching the cause

review_comments: Was it a bug that it had `readInt()` instead of `readUnsignedInt()` here? Or did you somehow accidentally change this? Other than this, this PR looks good, but I haven't tested it yet.

I understand that, but why did you change this line?

Edit: hmm… a size can't be negative, right?

* in somewhere was an overflow (the file was to big), so i discarded every possible overflow. Also, in mp4 box sizes are unsigned values, but since in DASH streams, bigger boxes llike `mdat` never reachs 2GB
* yes, size cannot be negative
